content.short: Reservoir is an NFT tooling platform used by developers.
content.description: Reservoir, launched in 2022, provides developers with expanded tools for navigating the NFT market. The platform offers APIs and SDKs that enable building NFT tooling, including aggregating listings across multiple marketplaces and the ability to implement advanced order types, such as collection-wide or trait-based bids. Reservoir supports the Ethereum blockchain and has been used to power platforms like Context and NFTGo, demonstrating its utility for cross-market NFT workflows. This enables developers to build NFT tools that operate across marketplaces and support sophisticated bidding strategies.
